{{Quote|I'm not looking for the Lost City to collect Jedi relics. I'm far more interested in the master computer that's said to be inside the Jedi Library.|The pseudo-Kadann|<ref name="PDS" />}}
A '''Jedi Library''' was erected by the old [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was part of the [[Lost City of the Jedi]],<ref name="LCJ" /> an undergound city and terraforming station that was built by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to nurture the moon's ecosystem back to health following the ravages of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="KORCG" /> The majority of the records contained in the library were located within a [[Grand Computer|master computer]] that possessed files placed in there by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The library's shelves also hosted antique [[Book/Legends|books]] and handwritten documents. Ancient Jedi relics and artifacts were also preserved within cases.<ref name="PDS" />

A hallowed building, the Jedi Library was flawlessy maintained by generations of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that sometimes ventured to the surface to gather information and update the database. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Jedi Library's sleek and shiny floor was soiled for the first time in millennia, when a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents led by the so-called [[Supreme Prophet]] of the Dark Side [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]] stormed the place. The false Prophet and his troops were trapped inside the Library by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces, and one of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] accidentally destroyed the grand computer.<ref name="PDS" />
